app.name: ArtisanalCanvas
app.summary: A Renaissance Perspective Academy for learning to design, compose, and decompose images and art: drawing practice, curriculum, eTextbooks, analytics, AI drawing feedback, an image studio, and a primitive library, with a geometry studio arriving from another version of the project.

codeSources.note: The current app. The Replit project runs this version.
A separate earlier Replit project with no git history in common with main: geometry studio, Prism cube, dock, curation dashboard. Browser-only, no server actions.

constraints: Do not change application code, routes, the app shell, database schemas, or stored user data during catalogue stages.
Do not merge or rewrite the warrenghaad branch; read it as incoming evidence only.
Do not build Prism, and do not use its workspace/row/column grid as catalogue chapters.
Do not present AI-generated images as the app or as a design.
Screenshots use sample data, never real student data or private uploads.
Keep catalogue records in this repository's catalogue/ folder; tool-local memory and task files may only point here.
The tier 1 template is seen only in Storybook until the owner approves wiring it into the app.
